[[Tracked Fleet]] (original printing): the first Players Committee card image, from the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/7821822/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual25-Dark/large/trackedfleet.gif trackedfleet.gif] commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/7821822 7821822] (7 August 2025), replaced 8 August 2025 by the released card ([[Tracked Fleet]]).
